## Renamed functions

# DuckDB's uuid() is typed UUID rather than a string, which the cast makes explicit.
SELECT LENGTH(CAST(GENERATE_UUID() AS STRING))
=> "36"

SELECT RAND() >= 0 AND RAND() < 1
=> "true"

SELECT IS_INF(CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64))
=> "true"

SELECT IS_NAN(CAST('nan' AS FLOAT64))
=> "true"

SELECT ABS(BIGNUMERIC '-1.5') = 1.5
=> "true"

SELECT JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR('{"a": 1}', '$.a')
=> "1"

SELECT JSON_QUERY('{"a": {"b": 1}}', '$.a')
=> "{\"b\":1}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(PARSE_JSON('{"a":1}'))
=> "{\"a\":1}"

## Where DuckDB's function of the same name differs

SELECT CONCAT('a', NULL)
=> null

SELECT CONCAT(b'a', CAST(NULL AS BYTES))
=> null

SELECT CONCAT('a', b, 'c') FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "axc"

SELECT GREATEST(1, NULL, 3)
=> null

SELECT LEAST(1, NULL, 3)
=> null

SELECT LEAST(2, 1, 3)
=> "1"

SELECT GREATEST('a', b) FROM t WHERE a = 2
=> "yy"

SELECT IS_NAN(GREATEST(1.0, CAST('nan' AS FLOAT64)))
=> "true"

SELECT IS_NAN(LEAST(1.0, CAST('nan' AS FLOAT64)))
=> "true"

SELECT LEAST(2, 1.5)
=> "1.5"

SELECT SAFE.MOD(5, 0)
=> null

SELECT MOD(CAST(NULL AS INT64), 0)
=> null

SELECT MOD(-5, 3)
=> "-2"

SELECT MOD(-9223372036854775808, -1)
=> "0"

SELECT MOD(NUMERIC '7.5', 2) = NUMERIC '1.5'
=> "true"

SELECT SAFE.MOD(NUMERIC '7.5', 0)
=> null

SELECT DIV(-7, 2)
=> "-3"

SELECT DIV(CAST(NULL AS INT64), 0)
=> null

SELECT REPEAT('ab', 2)
=> "abab"

SELECT REPEAT(b'ab', 2)
=> "YWJhYg=="

SELECT REPEAT('ab', 0)
=> ""

SELECT REPEAT(CAST(NULL AS STRING), -1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.REPEAT('ab', -1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.REPEAT('ab', 1000000)
=> null

SELECT IS_NAN(SIGN(CAST('nan' AS FLOAT64)))
=> "true"

SELECT SIGN(-2.5)
=> "-1.0"

SELECT SIGN(-5)
=> "-1"

SELECT SQRT(4)
=> "2.0"

SELECT SAFE.SQRT(-1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.EXP(1000)
=> null

SELECT EXP(CAST('-inf' AS FLOAT64))
=> "0.0"

SELECT SAFE.LN(0)
=> null

SELECT IS_NAN(LN(CAST('-inf' AS FLOAT64)))
=> "true"

SELECT SAFE.LOG(8, 1)
=> null

SELECT LOG(8, 2)
=> "3.0"

SELECT SAFE.POW(10, 400)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.POW(0, -1)
=> null

SELECT POWER(2, 10)
=> "1024.0"

# NUMERIC keeps its precision rather than going through FLOAT64.
SELECT SQRT(NUMERIC '2') = NUMERIC '1.414213562'
=> "true"

SELECT POW(NUMERIC '1.1', 2) = NUMERIC '1.21'
=> "true"

SELECT EXP(NUMERIC '1') = NUMERIC '2.718281828'
=> "true"

SELECT LOG(NUMERIC '1') = 0
=> "true"

SELECT LOG(NUMERIC '8', 2) = 3
=> "true"

SELECT CBRT(NUMERIC '-27') = -3
=> "true"

SELECT SQRT(CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC))
=> null

SELECT SAFE.SQRT(NUMERIC '-1')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.LOG(NUMERIC '8', 1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.POW(NUMERIC '10', 30)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.EXP(NUMERIC '100')
=> null

SELECT IS_NAN(SIN(CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64)))
=> "true"

SELECT IS_NAN(ASIN(CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64)))
=> "true"

SELECT SAFE.ASIN(2)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.SINH(1000)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ACOSH(0)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ATANH(1)
=> null

SELECT IS_NAN(ATANH(CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64)))
=> "true"

SELECT SAFE.COT(0)
=> null

SELECT IS_NAN(CSC(CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64)))
=> "true"

SELECT SECH(1000)
=> "0.0"

SELECT CBRT(-8)
=> "-2.0"

SELECT UNIX_SECONDS(TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00.5')
=> "0"

SELECT UNIX_SECONDS(TIMESTAMP '1969-12-31 23:59:59.5')
=> "-1"

SELECT UNIX_MILLIS(TIMESTAMP '1969-12-31 23:59:59.9995')
=> "-1"
